text: At d_model=256 the random controls reach 0.91-0.92 for distance and energy and 0.71 for accel_step, so distance and energy can no longer clear the 0.1 bar, and accel_step's headroom-normalised margin fell from 0.868 (d128) to 0.69 while its max-over-layers R2 is 0.97. Is the accel_step drop a control or best-layer artifact? Should width-scaling comparisons use trained R2 at a fixed layer for every target?
